editorial_notes: All93 actual source units in chapters45-47 received an initial curated pass and have at least one retained pair. Completion does not mean exhaustive discovery. All same-chapter relationships carry the explicit Same-chapter prefix.

Joseph's statements about sale, divine sending and preservation are distinguished from the narrator's merchant account and the later Stephen/psalm retellings. No unreported actor identity or exact mechanism of providence is invented.

The narrator's identification of Benjamin as Joseph's same-mother brother in43:29 is not put into Joseph's quoted speech. Joseph's speaking-mouth identity claim in45:12 is not made a claim about a language not specified in that verse.

The two robes for each brother, Benjamin's three hundred pieces of gold and five robe changes, the ten donkeys and ten female mules retain their supplied quantities and wording. Benjamin's earlier fivefold food portion is not turned into a fivefold robe allocation.
Jacob's rekindled spirit is not rewritten as literal resurrection. His readiness to die after reunion is distinguished from the later explicit seventeen-year Egyptian residence.

Well of the Oath, Harran, Goshen of Arabia, Heroopolis and the land of Rameses remain the actual supplied forms. Meeting-place, residence-region and other geographic descriptions are not merged into an invented site or modern map identification.

The night-vision response remains What is it, and the double name is compared with Exodus3:4 as supplied. God's different instructions to Isaac and Jacob about Egypt retain their different narrative settings.

The expanded Egyptian genealogy retains Joseph's Manasseh/Machir/Gilead and Ephraim/Soutalaam/Taam/Edem branches and Benjamin's three immediate sons, six Bala sons and Gera's Arad. These are not flattened into a different edition's lists or independently dated as births before the migration.

The named family-record comparisons establish common ancestral branches, family relationships or comparable lists. Each supplied personal name, generation level and membership difference remains intact; this does not claim new original-language identity resolution for every different name form.

Shaul's Canaanite mother in Genesis46:10 and Phoenician mother in Exodus6:15 remain the supplied descriptions. Jemuel/Iamun, Zambram/Shimron/Semeron, Aloel/Allel, and the Gad/Asher/Naphtali family forms are not silently normalized. Chronicles' Balaa wording remains distinct from Genesis' Bilhah.

The summaries of Leah33, Zilpah16, Rachel18 and Bilhah7 remain exact source counts; immediate sons and expanded family totals are not confused. Genesis46:26 sixty-six excluding sons' wives,46:27 Joseph's nine-soul Egyptian branch and total75, Exodus1:5 seventy-five, and Acts7:14 seventy-five remain supplied statements with their wording and scopes.
Deuteronomy10:22 separately supplies seventy. Its difference from Genesis' seventy-five is explicitly preserved without a new census explanation, arithmetic repair or imported harmonization.

Joseph's prepared report and the brothers' prepared occupational response are compared with the actual royal audience. Pharaoh's conditional direction concerning able livestock keepers is not made an appointment of every selected brother; which five were selected remains unstated.

Jacob's130 years before Pharaoh,17 years in Egypt and147-year total remain distinct chronological statements; Abraham175 and Isaac180 supply specific comparisons to his fathers. Hebrews' heavenly-homeland interpretation is attributed as a later theological reflection.

The famine transactions preserve silver payments, livestock barter, sale of land and bodies, the narrator's explicit enslavement wording, seed, the fifth and the four retained parts. People's reported gratitude is not presented as the narrator's universal ethical endorsement of enslavement.

Genesis47:18 second-year wording is not assigned a newly calculated absolute famine year. The chapter's priestly land and allowance exception is preserved alongside the general land-purchase statements.

The fifth proposed for the seven abundance years in41:34 is distinguished from the continuing crop fifth after the later land purchase in47:24-26. Neither arrangement is declared identical to a tithe or a timeless divine law, and to this day is not asserted as a modern Egyptian legal fact.

The burial oath gesture is compared with Abraham's distinct marriage commission. Jacob's request is connected with the later named ancestral cave and actual carrying to Canaan; Joseph's report to Pharaoh remains reported speech, not a replacement for the earlier wording.

The staff-worship wording of47:31 and Hebrews11:21 is retained. Their surrounding burial-oath and blessing contexts remain distinct; staff is not replaced with bed and no new textual-critical adjudication is claimed.

editorial_notes.note: The supplied positions, crossed hands, firstborn objection and deliberate choice remain distinct. Failing eyesight does not prove confusion. Knees are kept in12, and no independent legal adoption ritual or unreported extra children are inferred. Hebrews11:21 is labelled a later faith interpretation of the blessing, not a verbatim account of each physical detail.

Luz/Bethel and the earlier House of God/Oulamlous wording retain their source forms. The horse-course/Chabratha burial wording is preserved alongside Genesis35. Shechem through sword and bow, the earlier Hamor field purchase, Joshua's hundred-ewe-lamb purchase-and-gift account, and John's Sychar-area plot gift are compared without a new acquisition reconstruction or precise geographical equivalence.

Lifelong nourishment, the delivering angel, ancestral names and the promised return remain Jacob's words. No new identification of every angelic appearance or exhaustive interpretation of the return is supplied.

The twelve-son farewell is compared with Moses' later tribal blessing without calling the two lists identical. Reuben's hard-to-bear and stubbornly-self-willed wording is not replaced with a favourable firstborn formula.1Chronicles5:1-2 has blessing language concerning Joseph, not an imported Joseph's-sons formulation. Simeon and Levi's Shechem violence is linked specifically; bull-hamstringing is not inserted into the earlier narrative, and the later settlement comparisons do not exhaust the scattering saying.

Judah's lion-cub, shoot, ruler, things-reserved and expectation-of-nations forms are preserved. Numbers24:9 supplies closely corresponding lion imagery; Hebrews7:14 is a later Judah identity statement, not claimed as a direct quotation. Wine, blood of the grape, joyful eyes and white teeth are poetic images here; no medical or intoxication diagnosis is added. The unread Revelation5:5 candidate is excluded and separately pending.

The sea/Sidon saying is not made into a newly proven border map. Issachar desires good and rests between allotments, then becomes a tiller; no donkey or saddlebags are imported. Dan's judgment comparison uses the actual naming speech and the read Samson lineage context, without declaring Samson an exhaustive fulfilment. The serpent is not equated with an unreported individual or Eden figure. Psalm118:166 retains this edition's numbering. Naphtali is a spreading tree with beautiful fruit, not a silently substituted doe.

The doubled son-grown-great, envied and my-youngest-son forms remain unchanged, without a new explanation reconciling that address with Benjamin's birth order. Shattered bows and slack arms refer to the hostile plural context, not a substituted account of Joseph's bow remaining strong. The father-and-mother blessing and crown-of-the-brothers wording do not create an unreported maternal blessing scene. Benjamin's wolf is not identified with Saul, Paul or another unreported later figure.

The purchased Ephron cave opposite Mamre, sons-of-Heth possession and reported dug-tomb wording are retained without harmonizing every acquisition expression. Earlier records support Sarah, Abraham and Isaac's burial events; Rebekah and Leah's locations are not independently supplied by those earlier passages. The later Canaan/Mamre burial clause specifies the destination rather than creating a separate Atad burial.

The embalmers' preparation, forty days, Egyptian seventy-day mourning and later seven days at Atad remain distinct; no new combined total is asserted. Mourning of Egypt is the supplied place-name form. Kindred and livestock left in Goshen are not silently narrowed to children, and no unreported participant roster is reconstructed. The funeral chariots are not equated with a later military force.

The brothers' fear of revenge is their fear, and their father-oath claim remains their report. No independently narrated Jacob forgiveness conversation is invented. Verse18 contains an offer of household-slave status but no bowing action. Verse19 says I belong to God, not the familiar Am I in God's place formula. Joseph's provision and comfort answer the petition without supplying an otherwise unquoted forgiveness formula or accepting a new imposed enslavement.

Joseph's distinction between human evil intention and God's good purpose remains his stated interpretation, with earlier narrated wicked plotting preserved. The110-year notices and Ephraim's descendants remain as supplied. Machir's children are born upon Joseph's thighs, not silently changed to knees, and Joshua's tribal account is not used to invent personal military acts for the aged Egyptian household. The bones oath is explicitly followed through Exodus13:19 and Joshua24:32. Exodus1:5 retains its seventy-five figure.

critical_checks: Every actual source unit and retained target passage was read. No semantic, naming, numbering or relationship correction/removal is required in the bound186-pair file.

Joseph's disclosure, the brothers' fear/speech and his preservation interpretation remain attributed. Father-to-Pharaoh language is not made literal parentage, repeated questions do not acquire an invented motive, and rekindled spirit is not narrated resurrection.

Genesis37:28 retains twenty pieces of gold and its Midianite/Ishmaelite forms. Joseph's and Stephen's later accounts of fraternal responsibility do not silently resolve every earlier actor pronoun or seller label.

Benjamin's three hundred pieces of gold, five robe changes and the others' two robes remain distinct from the earlier fivefold meal portion. The robe allocation is not falsely described as a fivefold ratio. The father's journey provisions are not silently changed into another edition's animal/cargo descriptions.
Well of the Oath, Goshen of Arabia, Heroopolis and Rameses retain their actual forms. No modern border/site identity, universal travel prohibition, or unreported Pharaoh motive/appointment is added.

The Pharaoh question/answer and Jacob's130 years are distinguished from his147-year completed lifespan and17 Egyptian years. Abraham175 and Isaac180 are actual ancestral comparison ages. Hebrews' heavenly-homeland interpretation is labelled later interpretation.

The expanded Genesis46 genealogy retains Joseph's further generations and Benjamin's three immediate sons, six sons under Bala and Arad under Gera. These are not flattened into a conventional direct-son list or independently dated birth roster.

The Numbers26 targets use the actual supplied offsets and names. Aod/Saar versus Ohad/Zohar and Canaanite versus Phoenician, Jemuel versus Iamun, Zambram versus Shimron/Semeron, Gad's variant seven-name lists, Asher's Sara/Sarah/Sore and other forms remain as supplied.

Manasseh's Syrian concubine, Machir/Gilead versus Galaad and the Aseriel notice are retained without conflating Asenath or adding names to Genesis. Ephraim's Soutalaam/Taam/Edem are compared with Shuthelah/Tanach/Eden without claiming a new individual identity verification.

Asom versus Sami and the Naphtali names, including Chronicles' Balaa wording, are retained as parallel family records with differences. The earlier slave-woman descriptions and later wives descriptions are not silently homogenized.

The66 excluding wives, Egyptian Joseph-branch9, household75, Exodus75, Acts75 and Deuteronomy70 statements retain their stated scopes and numbers. No invented arithmetic reconciliation or conventional seventy-person replacement is claimed.

Narrated famine severity, spent silver, livestock barter, subsequent bodies/land proposal and actual enslavement remain distinct stages. The second-year clause is not forced into a new global famine chronology. Silver delivered to Pharaoh is not Joseph's independently asserted private gain.

Genesis47:21's explicit enslaved-as-slaves wording is not replaced with a population-transfer reading. The people's desperate request and later gratitude are their statements; neither becomes universal divine or narrator approval of slavery.

The land-of-priests allowance and no-sale exception qualify the all-land purchase and continuing ordinance. The fifth collected in the seven years of plenty remains distinct from the fifth-share produce arrangement following the purchase, with the retained four parts for seed/food stated accurately.

Household provision, Egyptian growth and later Psalm/Acts summaries are linked to particular recorded actions. They do not infer unreported economic exemptions for every member of Israel or an identity between officials with different titles.

The thigh gesture is compared with the earlier servant oath while keeping the commission different. The later cave instructions identify the burial place; Genesis47:31 and Hebrews11:21 both actually say staff, not bed, and their surrounding scenes are not collapsed.

peer_review_receipts.method: Independently read all actual source units, all retained targets and every rationale. Read additional lineage, song, Balaam, priesthood, property and burial context where needed. Distinguish quoted material, later faith interpretation, narrative correspondence, qualified tribal-settlement comparison and intra-chapter development. Verify the final TSV hash, exact source coverage, target text hashes, eleven pinned source identities, canon membership and absence of duplicate or self-containing pairs.

editorial_findings.finding: The children's birth order, Joseph's positioning, Jacob's crossed hands and explicit knowing/refusal remain distinct. Eyesight is not used to invent confusion or an adoption ceremony. The Hebrews blessing links are tied to actual blessing words and do not purport to repeat the physical crossing of hands.

Divine presence and return are linked without an exhaustive resolution of every return reference. The sword-and-bow statement, Hamor purchase, Amorite hundred-ewe-lamb account and plot given Joseph near Sychar retain their distinct wording. No independent purchase history or modern site equivalence is forced.

Reuben's severe character wording and the father's-bed offence are retained; Chronicles has its actual blessing-to-Joseph formulation. Simeon and Levi's narrative violence is linked specifically, with no invented bull-hamstringing incident in Genesis34. Settlement comparisons are qualified and do not declare every later tribal detail an exhaustive punitive fulfilment.

Balaam's actual lion/cub/rising question is read within its Israel-addressed setting. Hebrews identifies Jesus' Judah tribe in its priesthood argument; the rationale does not claim a quotation of the things-reserved prophecy. Grape-blood, milk and wine comparisons remain particular poetic abundance links, without medical or intoxication diagnoses.

Sea/Sidon language is not converted into a new boundary map. Issachar remains good-desiring, resting and tilling rather than a substituted donkey. Samson's Danite identity is actually supplied by Manoah's tribe and the birth account; he is not presented as the sole fulfilment. The serpent is not equated with Eden or an otherwise unreported individual. Psalm118:166 preserves the supplied numbering. Naphtali remains a spreading tree with beautiful fruit.

The grown-great/envied/youngest address is preserved without a fruitful-bough substitution or invented birth-order resolution. The shattered bows and slack arms remain those of the hostile plural context. Divine-help links do not invent an archery incident. The father-and-mother blessing, enduring-mountains/everlasting-dunes wording and brothers-led description remain alongside the different Deuteronomy imagery. Benjamin's wolf is not identified with an unreported later person.

Purchased cave descriptions and earlier burial evidence retain their actual scope; the retained older Isaac notice does not independently locate Rebekah or Leah. The Canaan/Mamre burial specification is read with the preceding burial wording without creating a new site history. Forty-day preparation, seventy-day Egyptian mourning and seven days at Atad remain distinct, with kindred and livestock rather than a substituted narrow roster.

The brothers' revenge fear and paternal-oath claim remain reported perspectives. Verse18 contains no bowing, and verse19 says I belong to God. Joseph's provision/comfort is not expanded into an unquoted forgiveness formula or narrated acceptance of new slavery. Human evil and God's good purpose remain Joseph's stated distinction.

The110-year notices, descendants upon Joseph's thighs and actual Machir tribal record are preserved. The bones oath is explicitly followed into Moses' taking the bones and the later burial notice. No personal military activity is invented for the Egyptian household.

Every source has an initial curated pass and retained support. Particular names, actions, repeated words, articulated comparisons or explicitly quoted references support the links; lower-count poetic verses are not padded with unverified individual identifications. All target identities and read texts resolve at the pin.
